overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: A snapshot of the academy today: catalogue, schedule, learners and certificates.
overview.refundsTitle: {count, plural, one {1 order needs a refund} other {# orders need a refund}}
overview.refundsBody: These orders were paid but could not be fulfilled, for example because the session filled up first. Refund them through your payment provider.

links.courses: Edit course content, prices and exams.
links.sessions: Schedule live sessions and record attendance.
links.inquiries: Reply to messages from the website.
links.audit: See who changed what, and when.

courses.title: Courses
courses.lead: The course catalogue. Only published courses appear on the public site.
courses.newLead: Add the course in both languages. A default exam is created with it, ready for you to add questions.
courses.editLead: Changes apply immediately to the public site and to new bookings.
courses.created: The course has been created. Next, schedule a session and add exam questions.

empty.title: No courses yet
empty.body: Create your first course to start scheduling sessions.

courseForm.codeHint: Short and unique, for example FA-101.
courseForm.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, numbers and hyphens, for example first-aid-essentials.
courseForm.listHint: For the lists below, write one item per line in each language.
courseForm.practicalNoteHint: Explains what this online course does not replace.
courseForm.syllabusNote: {count, plural, =0 {This course has no syllabus modules yet.} one {The existing syllabus (1 module) is kept exactly as it is.} other {The existing syllabus (# modules) is kept exactly as it is.}} Syllabus editing is not part of this release.
courseForm.syllabusNoteNew: The course is created without a syllabus. Syllabus editing is not part of this release.
courseForm.priceHint: Per learner, in Saudi riyals. Enter 0 for a free course.
courseForm.minAttendanceHint: Learners below this cannot sit the exam or receive a certificate.
courseForm.validityHint: Leave empty if the certificate never expires.
courseForm.published: Published: show this course on the public site and allow bookings

exam.title: Exam: {course}
exam.lead: Exam rules and the question bank for this course. Correct answers are visible on this page only, to administrators.
exam.reviewTitle: Assessment content must be reviewed by qualified people
exam.reviewBody: Questions marked “Sample” are placeholders for demonstration. Real safety assessments must be written and reviewed by qualified course owners before they are used with learners.

config.title: Exam rules
config.lead: These rules apply to attempts started after you save.
config.cooldownHint: Enter 0 to allow an immediate retake.
config.shuffleQuestions: Shuffle the order of questions for each attempt
config.shuffleOptions: Shuffle the order of answer options

bank.title: Question bank
bank.tooFew: Only {active} active questions are available, but each attempt needs {needed}. Add or activate questions, or lower the number of questions per attempt.

empty.title: No questions yet
empty.body: Add the first question below. Learners cannot sit the exam until the bank has enough active questions.

question.newLead: Every question has four options in both languages and exactly one correct answer.
question.optionsHint: Fill in all four options and select the correct one.
question.isSample: Sample question: placeholder content that has not been reviewed by a qualified course owner

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.lead: Every live session, newest first. Open a session to edit it, add the joining link and record attendance.
sessions.newLead: Schedule a live online session for a course.

empty.title: No sessions yet
empty.body: Schedule the first live session so learners can book.

needCourse.title: Create a course first
needCourse.body: A session belongs to a course. Add a course, then come back to schedule it.

sessionForm.instructorHint: The assigned instructor can see the roster and record attendance.
sessionForm.maxSeatsHint: Cannot be lower than the number of people already enrolled.
sessionForm.statusHint: A cancelled session asks its learners to take action. It does not refund them automatically.
sessionForm.joiningLead: Shown only to enrolled learners, the assigned instructor and administrators.
sessionForm.joinUrlHint: Create the meeting in Teams or Zoom, then paste its link here. It must start with https://. Meetings are not created automatically.

roster.title: Roster and attendance ({count})
roster.lead: Attendance is recorded manually. Learners need at least {percent}% attendance to sit the exam.
roster.auditNote: Every attendance entry and correction is written to the audit log with the previous and new values.
roster.notStarted: Attendance can be recorded once the session has started.

empty.title: Nobody is enrolled yet
empty.body: Learners will appear here as soon as they book this session.

enrollments.title: Enrolments
enrollments.lead: Every booking with its attendance, exam progress and certificate.
enrollments.cancelConfirm: Cancel the enrolment of {name}? This cannot be undone from here.
enrollments.cancelNote: Cancelling an enrolment is written to the audit log. It does not refund any payment automatically.

enrol.title: Enrol a learner
enrol.lead: Add an existing account to an upcoming session without payment, for example after a bank transfer.
enrol.emailHint: The learner must already have an account.
enrol.noSessions: There are no upcoming sessions to enrol into.

empty.title: No enrolments yet
empty.body: Bookings will appear here when learners enrol.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.reasonHint: Required. Kept on the certificate record and in the audit log.
certificates.reissueHint: Required. A new certificate with a new number will be issued if the learner still meets the requirements.
certificates.done: Done. The certificate list has been updated.
certificates.note: A revoked certificate shows as revoked on the public verification page straight away. Reissuing creates a new certificate with a new number.

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.body: Certificates are issued automatically when a learner meets the attendance minimum and passes the exam.

companies.title: Companies
companies.lead: Organisations that train their employees with the academy.

empty.title: No companies yet
empty.body: Companies appear here once they register.

inquiries.title: Inquiries
inquiries.lead: Messages sent from the contact and company forms. Open: {count}.

empty.title: No inquiries yet
empty.body: Messages from the website will appear here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: A permanent record of sensitive actions. Showing the latest {count} entries.

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.body: Sensitive actions will be listed here as they happen.

outbox.title: Email outbox
outbox.lead: The latest 100 messages generated by the platform.
outbox.demoBody: In this demonstration no email leaves the platform. Each message is saved here so you can read exactly what the recipient would have received.

empty.title: No emails yet
empty.body: Messages will appear here when the platform generates them.
